text:
Maria: Heads up — noticed our March reserved GPU credits didn't offset a chunk of US-WEST burst charges. Seeing ~ $23k of on-demand GPU charges that look like they should've consumed committed credits.

Alex: @maria can you paste the invoice id and sample charge lines? I can check credit mapping.

Maria: Invoice 2026-03-08-INV-9842
Charge lines:
```
2026-03-01  us-west1  on-demand g4dn.xlarge  540 hours  $23,120.00
2026-03-01  us-west1  reserved-commit GPU-pool-dedicated  720 hours  -$12,000.00
```
Looks like the reserved discount applied to the dedicated pool but burst/GPU-burst pool not covered.

Alex: Hmm — sounds like our commitment label didn't propagate to the 'gpu-burst' billing account. finance-bot: did the allocation rule for 'reserved-commit' run in March?

finance-bot: Allocation job ran 2026-03-02 02:00 UTC. 98% success. 2% of charges routed to 'cloud-burst' account due to missing tag 'commit-id:rdw-2026-q1'.

Sam: I ran the reconcile script against billing ledger — missing tags on instances spun by autoscaler when nodes reprovisioned during patch window. I'll attach the key peeker output.

Sam: snippet:
```json
{"instance":"gpu-burst-az1-22","labels":{},"launched_by":"k8s-autoscaler"}
```

Maria: So autoscaler-created nodes lost the tag causing them to be charged as on-demand. Any chance cloud provider will retro-apply credits?

Alex: We should open a case. @jen can you raise a support ticket with the provider with invoice and charge lines and ask for retroactive application citing the commitment contract ID: RDW-DEV-2026-Q1 and the missing tag issue? Also need an internal adjustment if provider declines.

Jen: On it. I'll create case 884332 and add triage notes + attach PVC of logs. ETA 4h.

Alex: Also need a short-term mitigation: Sam, can you add a pre-provision hook in the node pool template to ensure tag `commit-id:rdw-2026-q1` is present, and a nightly audit that fails the allocation job if coverage <99.5%?

Sam: Yep. I'll push a change to infra repo: `infra/gpu-nodepool/hooks/add-commit-label.sh` and schedule `billing-audit` job in cron.

Maria: Thanks — if provider applies retro credits we can close. If not, FinOps, we need to decide whether to absorb vs. billback customers using burst. Current exposure ~ $23k.

Alex: We should prepare a chargeback estimate. @maria please run `billing/usage/export --filter=gpu-burst --start=2026-03-01 --end=2026-03-10` and drop the CSV in this thread.

Maria: Uploaded `gpu_burst_march_patch_window.csv` to /shared/finance. 

finance-bot: Reminder: RDW-DEV-2026-Q1 reserved commitment expires 2026-06-30. 25% of credits already used.

Jen: Case 884332 created — ticket # with provider: CP-130987. I've attached invoice + sample node metadata. Provider acked receipt and asked for signed contract copy and proof of tag propagation policy.

Alex: I'll attach the contract and a short note from infra on the autoscaler behavior.

Sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/452 — adds label hook + audit job. Will monitor deploy today.

Maria: Great. I'll flag any future anomalies and update this thread when we hear back from provider.

Alex: Thanks team. Action items:
- Jen: provider ticket follow-up (within 4h)
- Sam: hotfix + audit (PR #452)
- Maria: run export + confirm CSV
- Alex: prepare chargeback options if provider declines

:thumbsup:
